# Supported devices

battbar is not affiliated with or endorsed by any of the vendors below; names are used only to
describe compatibility.

## What works without being listed

- **Logitech HID++ 2.0 devices** on a listed receiver, on a USB cable or over Bluetooth LE: name,
  type and battery feature are read from the device itself. Listing a device adds its PIDs,
  notes and (for voltage-only devices) a calibrated discharge curve.
- **Any Bluetooth device whose battery macOS already knows**: Bluetooth LE devices with the
  standard Battery Service, and classic Bluetooth audio devices (headphones, headsets).
- **Other SteelSeries headsets** through the optional [`headsetcontrol`](https://github.com/Sapd/HeadsetControl) fallback, if it is installed.

Something missing or wrong? See [ADDING_A_DEVICE.md](ADDING_A_DEVICE.md).

## Logitech HID++ devices

| Device | Type | Connections | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| G502 X PLUS | Mouse | Receiver (wpid `4099`)<br>USB cable (`C095`) | Battery via 0x1004 (Unified Battery), exact percentage. Verified on Lightspeed. |
| G915 Wireless Mechanical Gaming Keyboard | Keyboard | Receiver (wpid `407C`)<br>USB cable (`C33E`)<br>Bluetooth LE (`B354`) | Battery via 0x1001 (voltage) only; no serial number. Verified on Lightspeed and BLE (GATT). The BLE Battery Service value is not used (stays at 100 %). |
| Pebble Keys 2 K380s | Keyboard | Bluetooth LE (`B377`) | 2× AAA. Battery via 0x1004 (percentage from the firmware). Verified on Bluetooth LE. |
